newsitem.title: CANADA: Cominco sells 4.2 mln Aur shares.
newsitem.headline: Cominco sells 4.2 mln Aur shares.

text.p: Aur Resources topped the Toronto Stock Exchange actives list on Friday after Cominco Ltd sold its minority stake in the Toronto copper and base metals company.
Research Capital Corp said it crossed one block of 4.2 million shares, accounting for most of the morning volume of Aur. Aur shares rose 0.15 to 8.40.
Cominco's stake in Aur was less than 10 percent, "not a typical Cominco investment," Bob Stone, Cominco vice-president of finance, said in a phone interview.
The company decided now was a good time to sell the stock, he said.

He said Cominco would use the proceeds to help pay for three projects: a 40 percent expansion at its Red Dog zinc-lead mine in Alaska, a smelter modernization in Trail, British Columbia and work to expand its zinc refinery in Peru.
"I think it's good news for Aur," said base metals analyst John Hughes with Midland Walwyn in Toronto.
The sale gave Aur shareholders more liquidity at a time when the future looked encouraging for the company, he said.
He said Midland Walwyn expected the copper price to continue to rise over the next four months, aiding the fortunes of mid-sized copper producers such as Aur.
The Cominco sale was not a slight against Aur, he added.
"Cominco has an agenda of its own."
